fields.label: Your Devices
fields.description: One row per ZKTeco device. Add the device's name and IP address, save, then press Sync Attendance Now.

fields.label: Shift Types (Optional)
fields.description: Only needed if HRMS marks attendance for you automatically. Leave the box below as [] otherwise.

fields.label: Shift Type Device Mapping
fields.description:
Tells HRMS auto attendance how far the check-ins are complete. After every successful read of a shift's devices, that Shift Type's "Last Sync of Checkin" is set to the read time. Write a JSON list using your exact Shift Type names and the Device Names from the table above. Example:
[{"shift_type_name": "Morning Shift", "related_device_id": ["main-entrance"]}, {"shift_type_name": "Evening Shift", "related_device_id": ["main-entrance", "back-gate"]}]
Leave it as [] if you do not use auto attendance.
